import csv, json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path

SPEC = {"kind": "file_exists", "target": "research_answers.json"}


def report(status, observed, evidence=""):
    print(json.dumps({"status": status, "observed": observed, "evidence": evidence}))
    sys.exit(0)


def read_text(target):
    # A deliverable the checker cannot decode is a measured failure of the
    # deliverable, not a checker error.
    try:
        return target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
        report("fail", "target is not valid UTF-8 text", str(exc)[:200])


def main():
    root = Path(os.environ.get("VERIFIER_OUTPUT", "."))
    target = root / SPEC["target"] if SPEC["target"] else root
    kind = SPEC["kind"]

    if kind == "file_exists":
        ok = target.exists()
        report("pass" if ok else "fail",
               "present" if ok else "missing", SPEC["target"])

    if not target.is_file():
        report("fail", "target file missing", SPEC["target"])

    if kind == "columns":
        delim = "\t" if SPEC["target"].lower().endswith(".tsv") else ","
        header = next(csv.reader(read_text(target).splitlines(), delimiter=delim), [])
        missing = [c for c in SPEC["columns"] if c not in header]
        report("pass" if not missing else "fail",
               "header={}".format(header),
               "missing={}".format(missing) if missing else "")

    if kind == "row_count":
        lines = len(read_text(target).splitlines())
        want = SPEC["count"]
        # The spec does not say whether its count includes the header, so both
        # readings pass rather than manufacture a failure the task never stated.
        report("pass" if lines in (want, want + 1) else "fail",
               "lines={}".format(lines), "expected={}".format(want))

    if kind == "json_keys":
        try:
            data = json.loads(read_text(target))
        except ValueError as exc:
            report("fail", "target is not valid JSON", str(exc)[:200])
        present = set(data) if isinstance(data, dict) else set()
        missing = [k for k in SPEC["keys"] if k not in present]
        report("pass" if not missing else "fail",
               "keys={}".format(sorted(present)[:20]),
               "missing={}".format(missing) if missing else "")

    if kind == "enum":
        field = SPEC["field"]
        allowed = set(SPEC["allowed"])
        delim = "\t" if SPEC["target"].lower().endswith(".tsv") else ","
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(read_text(target).splitlines(), delimiter=delim))
        if not rows or field not in rows[0]:
            report("unverifiable", "column {!r} not present".format(field),
                   "allowed={}".format(sorted(allowed)))
        seen = sorted({str(r.get(field, "")).strip() for r in rows})
        bad = [v for v in seen if v not in allowed]
        report("pass" if not bad else "fail",
               "distinct={}".format(seen[:10]),
               "not_allowed={}".format(bad[:10]) if bad else
               "allowed={}".format(sorted(allowed)))

    report("unverifiable", "unknown check kind {!r}".format(kind))


main()

tests.script:
import json, os, re
from pathlib import Path
out = Path(os.environ['VERIFIER_OUTPUT'])
inp = Path(os.environ['VERIFIER_INPUT'])
questions = ['q1_multi_broker_reporting', 'q2_hft_cost_calculation', 'q3_software_naming']
try:
    data = json.loads((out / 'research_answers.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    manifest = json.loads((inp / 'document_manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    alias_map = {}
    for entry in manifest:
        for alias in entry.get('citation_aliases', []):
            alias_map[alias] = entry
    details = {}
    ok = True
    for q in questions:
        item = data.get(q) if isinstance(data, dict) else None
        citation = item.get('citation_document') if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        snippet = item.get('evidence_snippet') if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        entry = alias_map.get(citation) if isinstance(citation, str) else None
        citation_ok = entry is not None
        snippet_is_text = isinstance(snippet, str) and bool(snippet)
        has_cjk = snippet_is_text and re.search(r'[\u4e00-\u9fff]', snippet) is not None
        copied = False
        extract = None
        if entry is not None and snippet_is_text:
            extract = entry['staged_extract_path']
            text = (inp / extract).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
            copied = snippet in text
        qok = citation_ok and snippet_is_text and has_cjk and copied
        ok = ok and qok
        details[q] = {'citation_document': citation, 'resolved_doc_id': entry.get('doc_id') if entry else None, 'extract': extract, 'snippet_nonempty': snippet_is_text, 'snippet_has_cjk': bool(has_cjk), 'snippet_verbatim_in_cited_extract': copied}
    observed = details
except Exception as e:
    ok = False
    observed = {'error': type(e).__name__}
print(json.dumps({'status': 'pass' if ok else 'fail', 'observed': observed, 'evidence': {'questions_checked': questions}}, ensure_ascii=False))
